note: How to ask a logged-in coding agent one question and get one answer on stdout. Check each line against the tool's own --help; add your own agent in PROOFHOUSE_HOME/agent_commands.json with no code change. 'prompt' is 'stdin' (the question is piped in) or 'file' (a {prompt_file} placeholder in argv is replaced by a temp file). 'model_flag' is added only when a real model name is given (not 'default' and not the agent's own name).
